site/tests/e2e/a11y.spec.ts > modules/m8-lie-algebras/ times out at 120 s in this container: the axe scan alone took 120.2 s on 20470 elements with no serious violation. Raise its timeout or split the page.
Let the component pattern of registry-outs.spec.ts accept components/atlas/, so that T14.ts can import '@components/atlas/AtlasPicker.svelte' directly.
Nav.astro has no Atlas link, and released.ts has no static target for /atlas/. Add one so the index is reachable from the site navigation.
scripts/names.mjs typesets no affine name, so the Atlas shows C2~, B3~ and the like as plain data text. Add the 32 untwisted affine names (X~) to names.json to let them be typeset.
Optional: size.mjs classifies the Atlas pages as 'tool' (90 kB) because they carry data-tool; they fetch 0 scripts, so a static-sheet class with the 15 kB limit would match SPEC 7.6 more closely.

openQuestions: The T13 links of the real-form lines are built with the released mechanism, so they are absent on this branch and appear once P6-A3's T13 is merged. atlas.test.ts already decodes them; T14.spec.ts > links opens every tool link on the page, so it will open them after the merge.

The LaTeX check in T14.spec.ts compares line 3 with '\dynkin B{ooo}' (the 6.7 form), because lib/export.ts reads import.meta.env and cannot load in Playwright. The equality with exportLaTeX's own string is asserted in atlas.test.ts > downloads.
handoff: The Atlas is 32 static pages and an index, built at build time from atlasData, with no island and no script. Every value carries data-out and data-exact, and atlas.test.ts checks every value against the golden file. /tools/atlas and /embed/atlas render AtlasPicker. Merging this releases the Atlas: three tests of other owners (released.test.ts, M7.spec.ts, M8.spec.ts) assert its absence and need the updates listed under requests.
